title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages to support email delivery
description: Organizational Messages in Microsoft 365 will add email as a delivery channel, alongside Windows and Teams surfaces. Public Preview runs mid-November 2025 to late January 2026; General Availability starts mid-May 2026. Admins can send premade email templates, including Copilot welcome and weekly journey messages. No action needed now.

title: Updated UI for Copilot Chat entry point in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps
description: Microsoft 365 is updating Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint with a new Dynamic Action Button on the canvas, contextual prompts, and improved keyboard/screen reader access. Rollout starts December 2025, completing by May 2026. No admin action required unless changing pin settings for Copilot Chat.

title: Microsoft Edge for Business and Microsoft 365 Copilot: Introducing “What’s New” page after major updates
description: Microsoft Edge for Business will introduce a “What’s New” page that opens once after major updates, starting mid-February 2026. It informs users about new Edge and Microsoft 365 Copilot features. The feature is on by default but can be disabled by admins via policy. No prior admin action is required.

title: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint agents: A new Copilot experience for content creation
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces Word, Excel, and PowerPoint agents to assist with content creation via multi-turn chat, rolling out from February 9 to end of February 2026. Available to licensed users with Anthropic enabled, these agents help refine documents, analyze data, and generate presentations interactively.

title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Agent Mode in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Agent Mode in Microsoft 365 Copilot for PowerPoint allows users to edit presentations conversationally while preserving formatting and branding. Available mid-November 2025 for Windows Insiders Beta Channel users with a Copilot license, it uses enterprise data to enhance slides and is enabled by default.

title: PowerPoint adds AI-powered image editing with "Designer editor"
description: PowerPoint's new AI-powered Designer editor, rolling out from mid-December 2025 to March 2026, enables seamless in-app image editing with features like generative erase/move, text editing, background removal, and auto-enhance. It affects all Microsoft 365 users and cannot be individually disabled.

title: New experiences for Copilot management in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: The Microsoft 365 Admin Center will feature a redesigned Copilot landing page with success metrics, actionable insights, a Security pivot for Purview, and a Usage pivot. Rollout starts mid-November 2025 for targeted release and late January 2026 for general availability, requiring no extra setup.

title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to summarize and provide context from multiple open tabs and YouTube videos. The feature is off by default, respects existing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, requires Entra ID sign-in, and is managed via Edge and DLP policies.

title: New features coming to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is expanding: Outlook will analyze entire inboxes, calendars, and meetings; Agent Mode in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will assist content creation using web data and referenced files. Rollout began January 2026, completing by March, with no admin action required for most features.

title: Microsoft Learning Zone Windows app enabled by default for Education tenants
description: Starting January 1, 2026, Microsoft Learning Zone will be enabled by default for all Education tenants, allowing educators with Copilot+ PC devices to create AI-powered interactive lessons. IT admins can opt out anytime. The app supports lesson creation, preview, assignment, and sharing.

title: New features coming to Copilot Notebooks for Frontier users
description: New features for Copilot Notebooks in M365 Copilot apps will roll out from November 2025 to March 2026, enhancing navigation, personalization, and AI capabilities. Updates include a streamlined interface, personalized suggestions, an overview page, and expanded reference types. No admin action is needed; features enable by default.

title: Announcing the new pay-as-you-go experience in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
description: Microsoft 365 Admin Center introduces a new pay-as-you-go experience for managing Backup and Copilot billing starting January 15, 2026. Admins can create billing policies, set budgets, and view usage under the Billing node. Migration details for existing Backup customers will be announced later. No immediate action required.

title: Decoupling admin controls for agents on/off from Researcher and Analyst
description: Researcher and Analyst remain available to all M365 Copilot license users even if Copilot agents are disabled in Agents Settings. This update, rolling out from December 15, 2025, affects IT admins managing agent access and requires reviewing access controls and updating documentation accordingly.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Configure connected agents for Researcher and other agents
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support connected agents, allowing one agent to query others for data, starting with Researcher in Q4 2025. Rolling out mid-November 2025 to February 2026, admins can manage connected agents, users can enable/disable them per conversation, and up to 10 connected agents are allowed.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Android: Preview and chat with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files in the Copilot app
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Android now allows previewing Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with Copilot Chat, but editing requires switching to standalone apps. Offline access and advanced file management move to standalone apps. Tenant admins should prepare by deploying these apps and updating user communications.

title: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot: Discover and create agentic users from Teams and M365 Agent Store
description: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce AI-powered Agentic Users—autonomous virtual colleagues with full organizational identities. Available from mid-November 2025, users can discover and request agent templates, with admins controlling creation and licensing. Agents interact via Teams, email, and meetings, enhancing productivity and learning over time.

title: Introducing the Explore Pane in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces the Explore Pane, a guided side panel in Create, Search, and Notebooks modules to help users navigate AI features. Rolling out worldwide from early to late December 2025, it’s enabled by default for all Commercial SKU users with no admin action needed.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Q&A in Read Aloud enables real-time voice interactions
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Read Aloud now supports real-time voice Q&A for en-US users starting February 2026, enhancing accessibility and comprehension. This interactive feature requires a Copilot license, is enabled by default, and allows users to toggle between classic and new experiences without admin changes.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Podcast voice interactions make audio experiences conversational
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will enable real-time voice interactions in podcasts starting April 2, 2026, initially for en-US. This feature allows users to ask questions during audio overviews, enhancing engagement without admin changes. It will be on by default for eligible users with Copilot licenses.

title: New Copilot button in file previewer for OneDrive and SharePoint
description: A new Copilot button will appear in the bottom-right corner of the OneDrive and SharePoint file previewer, replacing the command bar button. It provides access to Copilot chat and contextual prompts for paid Copilot license users. Rollout begins mid-November 2025, excluding GCC, GCCH, and DoD customers.

title: Microsoft Teams: Channel agent orchestration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: Microsoft Teams' Channel Agent integration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP) rollout is paused. This feature enables task orchestration across tools within Teams, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and will be previewed with admin enablement when resumed.

title: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks: Overview page with Copilot-powered summaries and insights
description: Microsoft is introducing Copilot-powered summaries and insights as the default landing page in Copilot Notebooks, starting with web preview in November 2025 and general availability by March 2026. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required, and no user action is needed to enable this feature.

title: Microsoft Purview | New Copilot Security Controls in Microsoft Admin Center
description: Microsoft Purview introduces new Copilot security controls in Microsoft Admin Center, including a default DLP policy in simulation mode, visibility into oversharing risks, and admin-configurable protections. Rollout begins mid-November 2025 (preview) and mid-January 2026 (general availability). Entra admin roles are required for policy management.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to support Microsoft 365 Copilot, preventing sensitive data in prompts from being used or returned in responses. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability begins late March 2026. Admins can configure DLP policies via the Purview portal.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing the pre-purchase plan (P3)
description: Microsoft Copilot Studio launches a Pre-Purchase Plan (P3) on November 1, 2025, offering annual prepaid Commit Units with discounts, a single usage meter across Copilot Studio, Dynamics 365, and Moveworks, MACC eligibility, and Pay-As-You-Go overage billing. Preparation includes choosing credit options and aligning budgets.

title: Microsoft Copilot Chat: AI disclaimer updates
description: Microsoft Copilot Chat's AI disclaimer will be updated with admin controls for customization, including bold text and a custom URL. Rollout starts early December 2025, completing by mid-December for most and mid-January 2026 for GCC High & DoD. Admins should review and prepare accordingly.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Introducing Researcher with Computer Use
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces Researcher with Computer Use, enabling secure interaction with public and gated web content via a virtual computer. Launching October 30, 2025, it requires a Copilot license, allows advanced content generation, and is admin-configurable with default enabled status.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot employee experience outcomes report with Viva Glint in the Copilot Analytics dashboard
description: A new Power BI report in Microsoft Viva Insights links Microsoft 365 Copilot usage with employee sentiment from Viva Glint surveys. Available late 2025, it requires licenses, admin setup, and integration between Viva Glint and Viva Insights to analyze engagement, sentiment, and improve Copilot adoption.

title: Microsoft Outlook: Enhanced search experience with Copilot in Classic Outlook
description: Classic Outlook will gain a Copilot side pane showing AI-generated summaries of search results from documents and Teams messages. Users can interact with and ask follow-up questions in the pane. The feature rolls out mid-December 2025 to mid-February 2026, enabled by default for commercial M365 Copilot license holders.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Capacity pack support for SharePoint agent and Copilot tuning
description: Microsoft 365 admin center will introduce Capacity Pack support for SharePoint Agents and Copilot Tuning in late October 2025, allowing prepaid message bundles to manage costs before pay-as-you-go charges. Admins can allocate packs, monitor usage in PPAC, and control environments via Entra ID. No prior action needed.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Session persistence enhancement for Copilot chat
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot chat will preserve conversations by creating session entries in the navigation pane upon prompt submission, allowing users to return without losing progress. This update, rolling out from December 2025 to June 2026, requires no admin action and improves chat reliability across all environments.

title: Copilot Pages: New feature—M365 Copilot Chat can now answer questions about the currently open page
description: M365 Copilot Chat now creates and updates Copilot Pages via chat prompts, answers questions based on the open page content, and offers improved on-page interactions. The feature rolls out worldwide from October 2025 to February 2026, is on by default, respects existing policies, and requires user communication and training updates.

title: Microsoft OneDrive: floating Copilot button simplifies Copilot discovery
description: Starting October 15, 2025, OneDrive will roll out a floating Copilot button for Microsoft 365 Copilot users, enabling quick access to AI-powered file actions and contextual suggestions. The feature is enabled by default, requires no configuration, and aims to improve efficiency within the OneDrive web interface.

title: Microsoft Copilot Analytics: Data export public preview for Copilot metrics in the Copilot dashboard
description: Microsoft is introducing a default-on public preview of a data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. It enables export of de-identified, weekly Copilot usage metrics from the past six months to analyze adoption and optimize licensing. Requires 50+ Copilot licenses.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Graph APIs for agent and app management
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces two new Graph APIs for admins to manage agents and apps programmatically, enabling automated reporting and integration. Available in Public Preview from May 1, 2026, with worldwide rollout by early May. No additional licenses needed; existing Microsoft 365 licenses suffice.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: New usage intensity metrics available in admin center report
description: New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage intensity metrics will be available in the admin center report by late October 2025, showing prompt counts, daily trends, and active days at organization and user levels. No admin action is needed before rollout; admins should inform stakeholders and review updated reports.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: MCP-based agents now available in Copilot and Microsoft 365 admin center
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports MCP-based agents, allowing developers to build and admins to manage these agents via the Copilot Agent Store and admin center. Rollout starts mid-November 2025, is on by default, and requires no immediate action but recommends reviewing agent catalogs and updating documentation.

title: Manage SharePoint agents in Copilot Control System: View, block, or unblock agents used in Copilot Chat
description: Microsoft 365 admins can now manage SharePoint agents in Copilot Chat via a new Agents section in the Copilot Control System. They can view, block, or unblock agents starting late September 2025. This feature is enabled by default and only affects Copilot Chat.

title: Microsoft Loop: Copilot experience upgrade
description: Microsoft Loop is upgrading its Copilot experience to align with Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages, temporarily removing older integrations starting September 9, 2025. The update will provide consistent, improved Copilot features across chat and pages. Users should update training materials accordingly; no compliance changes are expected.

title: New setting to pin Microsoft 365 Copilot and Companion apps to the Windows taskbar.
description: Admins can now pin Microsoft 365 Copilot and companion apps (People, File, Calendar) to the Windows taskbar via a new setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout starts October 2025, with the toggle off by default. Pinning applies only if apps are installed and can be managed by admins.

title: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption trends and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in February 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and agent insights, accessible via Viva Insights, with controls for managing access and no identified compliance issues.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Information about billing plan setup for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
description: Starting October 3, 2025, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat Pay-as-you-go billing plans must be set up via the Microsoft 365 admin center, not the Power Platform admin center. Existing plans remain active, and there is no impact on user experience or compliance. Admins should prepare for this transition.

title: New support for HR and employee profile data in Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports enhanced HR and employee profile data connectors, including a BambooHR prebuilt connector and custom connectors via Microsoft Graph. Administrators can configure these to enrich people profiles, improving Copilot’s contextual responses across Microsoft 365 experiences. Public preview runs mid-May to mid-November 2025; general availability begins mid-November 2025.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Version history now available in Copilot Pages
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages now includes version history, allowing users to view and restore previous page versions, including manual, Copilot, or collaborative changes. This feature, enabled by default without needing a Copilot license, rolls out worldwide from October to November 2025 and requires no admin setup.

title: Microsoft Outlook: Summarize email with Copilot chat
description: Microsoft Outlook now offers email and attachment summarization via Copilot chat for Android and iOS users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Rollout on Web, Mac, and Desktop is paused. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin setup, and respects existing policies. No action is needed.

title: Microsoft Outlook: Declarative Agents in Copilot Chat coming to classic Outlook for Windows
description: Declarative Agents in Copilot Chat will be available in classic Outlook for Windows starting January 2026, enabling users to customize Copilot with plugins and connectors. Enabled by default for Copilot license holders, admins can manage agent settings via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Advanced features require admin opt-in and billing setup.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio icon update
description: By October 2025, Microsoft Copilot Studio will have an updated icon across its web and Microsoft 365 Copilot interfaces. This visual change aligns with the Microsoft 365 Copilot brand, affects all users, involves no functional changes, requires no admin action, and has no compliance impact.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent Mode available in Excel Labs add-in (Frontier preview)
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Agent Mode in Excel Labs (Frontier preview) enables natural language workbook editing, available from October 21, 2025, for Frontier program customers. Admins must enable Frontier access; users can toggle features in Copilot. More features and languages are coming, with no identified compliance issues.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updates to memory and personalization
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot updates Memory to personalize responses using chat history, with refreshed user controls for managing Saved Memory. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability begins mid-September 2026. Existing admin settings remain unchanged, and users can control personalization via updated settings.

title: [Copilot Chat] Upload multiple reference images to create new images
description: Users of Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365 will soon be able to upload multiple reference images per session, enhancing image generation. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out globally in late September 2025 with no admin action required. Organizations may update support and documentation accordingly.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Chat for Teams Chats, Channels, Calling, and Meetings
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now integrated side-by-side in Teams Chats, Channels, Calling, and Meetings for licensed users on desktop and web. New in-meeting controls allow stopping audio processing. Rollouts occur from October 2025 to September 2026. Admins must enable the Copilot app for access.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Prepurchase capacity packs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
description: Microsoft 365 admin center will introduce prepaid Capacity Packs for Copilot Chat, offering 25,000 messages/month to manage costs before pay-as-you-go charges. Rollout starts late September 2025. Features include usage monitoring, departmental allocation, automatic PAYG fallback, and no required admin action before rollout.

title: Introducing Knowledge Agent (preview): AI-powered content optimization for SharePoint and Copilot
description: Knowledge Agent is a new SharePoint AI feature preview starting September 2025, offering role-based content optimization and intelligent actions via a floating button. It requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses for ready-made agents, changes agent access and icons, and allows admins to manage opt-in/out per site.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot App for Windows: "Update available" button
description: Starting January 2026, the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows will show a non-blocking "Update" button in the top-right corner when a new version is available. Users can update immediately or later without interrupting app use. No admin action is needed; communicate this change to users.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Apps installation on devices with Microsoft 365 Apps
description: Starting June 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot app will auto-install on Windows devices with Microsoft 365 apps, unless admins opt out. Rollout runs mid-June to mid-July. No changes for EEA customers. Inform users beforehand; no compliance issues identified.

title: Expanding Microsoft 365 Copilot Search admin experience to AI admin role
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Search admin experience is expanding to AI Admin and Global Reader roles, allowing designated admins to manage or view Copilot Search settings. This rollout begins late September 2025, is enabled by default for eligible tenants, and access is controlled via Microsoft Entra ID.

title: New SharePoint assessment and dashboard to streamline site governance and Copilot readiness
description: The updated SharePoint Content Management Assessment (CMA) launches October 2025, offering admins a unified dashboard to evaluate site health, permissions, and lifecycle readiness. It automates governance tasks, enhances Copilot preparation, requires specific licenses, and stores data per SharePoint residency rules.

title: Library experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a new Library experience by mid-October 2025, consolidating Copilot-generated images and Pages into one section. The Pages menu will be removed, with no admin action needed. Library is enabled by default for users with Copilot chat enabled.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI workflows powered by Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: AI Workflows in the Teams Workflows app use Microsoft 365 Copilot to automate tasks via scheduled prompts and templates, available to licensed users. Rolling out late 2025 to early 2026, the feature is off by default and requires enabling the Workflows app in Teams. Admin controls allow disabling it.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Unified Exclusion list
description: Microsoft Viva Insights introduces a Unified Exclusion list for Copilot Analytics, allowing admins to exclude specific users consistently across all Viva Insights features. Rolling out globally from October 2025, it simplifies management via CSV or Entra ID groups, ensuring consistent privacy controls and data reporting organization-wide.

title: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat’s Writing Assistance will roll out in Edge for Business by late January 2027, enabled by default. Users can access it via right-click on editable text. Admins can control it with the InlineComposeEnabled policy. DLP policies may restrict its functionality on certain content.

title: Microsoft Copilot dashboard (in Viva Insights): New benchmarks to compare Copilot usage across organizations
description: Microsoft is adding benchmarks to the Copilot dashboard in Viva Insights, enabling organizations to compare internal and external Copilot usage. Rollout begins mid-October 2025. Benchmarks use anonymized data, include admin controls, and help improve adoption strategies. Organizations should review access and update training accordingly.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Scoped knowledge support for declarative agents in VIP connectors
description: Scoped knowledge support in Microsoft 365 Copilot's declarative agents for VIP connectors (Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence) enables precise, personalized query responses by limiting accessible information. Available to Microsoft 365 E5 tenants, it rolls out globally from late August to early September 2025. Configuration involves selecting connectors and scoping attributes.

title: Microsoft Copilot dashboard (in Viva Insights): Adoption metrics for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
description: Microsoft is adding M365 Copilot Chat adoption metrics to the Microsoft Copilot dashboard in Viva Insights, showing usage trends and engagement for unlicensed users. Rolling out from October to December 2025, the feature is on by default, with admin controls to disable or exclude users.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center – Usage reports: Copilot Search usage
description: A new Copilot Search usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center by early September 2025, showing user activity and search metrics. It is enabled by default, requires no setup, and helps organizations monitor Copilot Search adoption and usage trends.

title: Executable name update for Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows
description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows will change its executable name from Webviewhost.exe to M365Copilot.exe after late October 2025. The update is automatic for Microsoft Store users with auto-updates enabled. No functionality changes occur; update dependencies if needed.

title: Microsoft Teams Copilot without transcription becomes default for meetings - conversation history now persists
description: Microsoft Teams Copilot's default mode would switch to no transcription with persistent conversation history, but this change is currently not proceeding. Affected tenants must manually enable transcription for post-meeting queries. Admins can adjust policies to retain current behavior; tenants updated after June 2024 are unaffected.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: New ways to include files and emails in prompts
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now allows users to include files and emails in prompts by typing '/' in Outlook, enhancing prompt relevance and usability. Email access rollout is from October 2025 to March 2026. No admin action is needed; users see only content they have permission to access.

title: New admin control in Microsoft 365 admin center for org-wide sharing of user-built Copilot agents
description: Microsoft 365 is introducing a new tenant-level admin control to manage who can create org-wide sharing links for user-built Copilot agents. Rolling out from October to late October 2025, admins can customize sharing permissions to align with organizational policies via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: new service listing in Service health and Message center
description: Microsoft 365 is introducing a new service listing, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, in Service health and Message center to improve communication visibility for Copilot Chat users. It will roll out worldwide by September 2025, requires no action, and does not affect service functionality.

title: Viva Engage: Public discussions now available in Workplace Search and Copilot Search
description: Viva Engage public discussion posts will appear in Microsoft 365 search results on Office.com, SharePoint.com, and Copilot Search starting late November 2025. No admin action is needed, content visibility respects user access, and a Copilot license is required for Copilot Search. Inform users accordingly.

title: Microsoft Outlook: Updated Copilot Chat interface with new conversation view
description: The Outlook Copilot Chat interface is updated with the navigation pane moved from right to left, aligning with other Microsoft 365 apps. It includes access to agents, conversation history, and a new All Conversations page. The rollout begins mid-August 2025, requires no admin action, and aims to improve usability.

title: Outlook Mobile : Copilot Chat overlay coming to iOS and Android
description: Outlook Mobile will roll out a context-aware Copilot Chat overlay for iOS and Android from late September 2025 to early March 2026. It enables users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses to interact with AI while using email, calendar, and contacts, providing personalized, on-screen contextual assistance. No action is needed.

title: Copilot Chat usage in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote now included in Copilot Analytics
description: Copilot Chat usage in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote is now included in Microsoft 365 admin center and Viva Insights reports, enhancing Copilot Analytics. Updates will reflect user activity across these apps, improving adoption tracking and AI adoption scores with future enhancements planned.

title: Streamlined file preview and Copilot Chat experience in Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iOS
description: Starting September 15, 2025, the Microsoft 365 Copilot iPhone app will offer file previews and Copilot Chat for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files but will no longer support editing; users must open standalone apps for editing. Similar updates will follow for iPad. No admin action is required, but user communication is recommended.

title: Streamlined file preview experience in Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iOS
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iOS will shift to AI-powered file previews and chat for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, directing editing to standalone apps. File management will move to OneDrive. Rollout begins September 2025 with phased updates for iPhone and iPad. Organizations should prepare users and update training accordingly.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage intensity and host apps metrics available in Copilot Chat usage report
description: New Microsoft 365 admin center metrics track Copilot Chat usage intensity and app-specific engagement for users without Copilot licenses across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Available worldwide from mid-August 2025, these daily-updated metrics enhance adoption reporting and impact existing custom reports.

title: Manager insights now in Viva Insights web app, with new team view for Copilot Dashboard
description: The Viva Insights web app will become the central hub for manager insights, featuring a team-scoped Copilot Dashboard, additional tailored reports, delegation support, and analyst-published reports. This replaces manager capabilities in the Viva Insights Teams app, rolling out worldwide from mid-September to early October 2025.

title: Gen AI capabilities in the Create module of Microsoft 365 Copilot app coming to all Copilot Chat users
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Create module now offers generative AI image and visual content creation to all Copilot Chat users without a license, with standard access and existing admin controls applying. Video, survey, and brand kit features remain restricted. Rollout began mid-August for desktop, with mobile following in October 2025.

title: Microsoft Copilot: filter chat history for easier context recall
description: Microsoft Copilot will add a chat history filtering feature starting late August 2025, enabling users to quickly find relevant past conversations. The feature is on by default, requires no admin setup, and aims to improve navigation and context recall in Copilot chats.

title: [Copilot Extensibility] Admins can manage ownerless Copilot agents with new lifecycle controls
description: Admins will gain lifecycle controls to identify, review, delete, or block ownerless Copilot agents created by departed users, improving security and governance. The feature rolls out globally from late August to mid-September 2025, with owner assignment for agents coming in October. No prior configuration is needed.

title: GPT-5—OpenAI’s latest generative-AI system—is now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: GPT-5 is now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio, offering dynamic model selection for faster or deeper responses. Users with a Copilot license get priority access via a toggle in Copilot Chat. No admin action is needed, but informing users and updating documentation is recommended.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | View recent activity in Word with Dynamic Document Snapshot
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word introduces an Activity tab showing recent comments and edits, with filters by time. Rolling out globally from late July to August 2025, it enhances collaboration by summarizing document changes. The feature is on by default, requiring no user action.

title: Simplifying Microsoft 365 Copilot app web experiences
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat web access is being simplified by consolidating entry points from copilot.cloud.microsoft to m365.cloud.microsoft/chat, reducing user confusion. The change starts mid-September with automatic redirection, requires no admin action, and does not affect data processing or AI capabilities.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Mobile App: Bottom tabs removal and default land to Chat
description: Starting early August, Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will remove bottom tab navigation, making Copilot Chat the default for users with access and pinning. Other features move to the hamburger menu. Chat history will be expanded by default. iOS updates begin in August, Android follows. Admins can manage pinning settings.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Mobile App: Removal of Apps section
description: Starting early August 2025, the Apps section will be removed from the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app's hamburger menu on iOS and Android. Users can still access apps via desktop, web, or dedicated mobile apps. The update is automatic, requires no admin action, and does not affect permissions.

title: Enhanced Personalization via Communication Memory in Copilot
description: Starting September 2025, Microsoft 365 Copilot will use AI to remember key highlights from users' emails, chats, and meetings to provide personalized responses across apps. This communication memory is private, stored securely in users' mailboxes, enabled by default, and manageable by admins via Microsoft Graph.

title: Microsoft Outlook: Copilot chat now available to summarize emails for more users
description: Microsoft Outlook will roll out a Copilot chat feature to summarize email threads with one click, available to users with Copilot chat pinned, even without a Copilot license. The rollout starts late August 2025, is on by default, manageable by admins, and includes compliance and audit considerations.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Set budget limits for "Pay-as-you-go billing" in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: Microsoft 365 Admin Center will add budget controls for Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing, allowing global and billing admins to set budget limits, receive customizable alerts, and view six months of spending data. Rollout starts mid-July 2025, with no automatic service shutdown at budget limits.

title: New Tools feature coming to the Microsoft Copilot Chat prompt box
description: Starting October 2025, a new Tools feature will appear in the Microsoft Copilot Chat prompt box, offering easy access to task-specific AI capabilities based on user licenses. Rollout completes by February 2026, requires no admin action, and enhances feature discoverability and usability.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | PowerPoint now supports enterprise image libraries via SharePoint OAL or Templafy
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will support enterprise image libraries via SharePoint OAL or Templafy starting early November 2025. Admins can connect branded image libraries to enable users to generate slides with organizational images, ensuring brand consistency. Setup requires metadata-rich images and admin configuration.

title: Standard and Priority access to Copilot capabilities
description: Starting early August 2025, Microsoft 365 Copilot shifts to capacity-based access for some features. Non-licensed Copilot Chat users get standard access subject to availability, while licensed users have priority. Rollout completes by late October. No admin action is needed; upgrades enable priority access.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Chat now supports new file types in search grounding
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now supports additional file types like CAD, ZIP, and MP4 for search grounding, enhancing response relevance. The rollout begins early August 2025, with no user interface changes. Users must have eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses; the feature is enabled by default.

title: New Copilot setting for pinning the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to the Windows Taskbar
description: A new setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center allows admins to pin the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to the Windows taskbar for easier access. This setting, off by default, applies to Intune-managed Windows 10 and 11 devices. It will roll out starting at the end of July.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Viva Engage discussion posts added to grounding sources
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now includes Viva Engage discussion posts from public communities and Storylines as grounding sources, enhancing contextually relevant responses. This feature, rolling out from June to August 2025, requires no admin action and does not include private content. Review Viva Engage configurations and notify relevant parties.

title: Microsoft Edge:  Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat entry point in Microsoft Edge for Business
description: Microsoft Edge for Business will add two Microsoft 365 Copilot entry points: a context menu for page summaries and Find on Page integration, rolling out by August 2025. Features are on by default, respect DLP policies, and enable new AI-driven browser interactions without requiring admin action before rollout.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot using content with sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Microsoft 365 Copilot is now generally available, allowing organizations to use DLP policies to detect sensitivity labels and restrict access to sensitive content. The rollout begins in late June 2025 and completes by late July 2025. Admins can edit or create new policies and use alerting and simulation features.

title: Microsoft Copilot: Access SharePoint agents in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Access recently used SharePoint agents directly within the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, starting mid-September 2025. This feature aims to reduce context switching and improve productivity. Admins can manage agents by deleting the corresponding .agent files. Update training materials and review SharePoint agent management practices.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Now Easily Accessible from the Teams Chat List
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will be accessible from the Teams chat list for users without a Copilot license starting June 30, 2025. This new entry point simplifies navigation without changing default pinning behavior. No action is required, but informing users about this update is recommended.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Extending Copilot Chat to Microsoft 365 apps
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is being rolled out across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook on multiple platforms starting mid-2025. It respects user state, requires no admin action unless pinning is disabled, and does not change data processing or AI capabilities.

title: Microsoft Viva Insights: New prompt categories in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard
description: Microsoft Viva Insights now offers new prompt categories in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard via Public Preview, including Ask and find, Catch up, Draft and brainstorm, and Other. These categories appear in adoption and impact tabs with no admin action needed. General Availability updates will follow later.

title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Copilot adoption community now available to all tenants
description: The Copilot adoption community in Microsoft Viva Engage is now available to all customer tenants without requiring a Copilot license. This community helps organizations with the rollout and adoption of Copilot by providing a platform for questions, best practices, and peer support. Available now.

title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Copilot shows users important emails in new priority view
description: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android introduces a new priority view highlighting important emails and those needing replies, available from late June 2025 to late December 2025. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required. Users can enable this feature in Outlook settings and customize the view. No admin action is needed.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails with sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will soon restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails labeled with sensitivity starting January 1, 2025. The feature rolls out June to September 2025, requires no Copilot license, and allows admins to create or extend DLP policies via the Purview portal automatically.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: GA for Image Generation in Copilot Chat
description: Image generation in Microsoft 365 Copilot will be generally available from late June to late July 2025. Users with a Copilot license can generate images within Microsoft 365 apps. No admin action is required, but informing users and updating documentation is recommended. Compliance considerations involve AI data processing and interaction.

title: Copilot Dashboard: Updated meeting metrics for Intelligent Recap
description: The Copilot Dashboard now includes updated meeting metrics combining summarized and recapped activities, replacing prior Copilot Assisted Hour calculations. These changes, rolling out from late 2025, enhance visibility into Intelligent Recap usage in Teams and are reflected in both the dashboard and M365 Copilot Impact report with added query options.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Access agents from the Microsoft Edge sidebar
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot agents will be accessible from the Edge sidebar starting late September 2025. Users must pre-add agents to access them there but cannot create or add new ones via the sidebar. The feature is automatic, default-enabled, and enhances multitasking without screen switching.

title: Microsoft Viva Insights | Copilot Analytics: Unified experience for Copilot Dashboard and Insights analyst workbench
description: Microsoft Viva Insights will roll out a unified Copilot Analytics experience for Copilot Dashboard users and Viva Insights analysts from late June to mid-July 2025. This update will migrate existing settings and provide new reporting capabilities. No action is required from admins, but they may update policies and training.

title: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Create a presentation with Microsoft Copilot from the PowerPoint Backstage view
description: Users will soon be able to create PowerPoint presentations with Microsoft Copilot from the Backstage view. This feature requires Microsoft 365 and Copilot 365 licenses. Rollout starts in June 2025, with general availability by early July 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
description: Microsoft 365 admin center introduces a preview usage report for managing metered costs of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing. It shows message consumption by tenant, user, and agent, with alerts for over 2000 messages. Rollout starts end of April 2027, no admin action needed.

title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 Copilot for phone without transcription
description: Microsoft Teams is releasing a feature allowing users to use Copilot during live calls without retaining transcripts or audio recordings. This will roll out in July 2025. Admins will have settings to configure this feature. Post-call functions like recaps will not be available.

title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft 365 Copilot view in Data Security Posture Management for AI
description: Microsoft Purview will include a page in Data Security Posture Management for AI to show protection capabilities and usage for Microsoft 365 Copilot. This feature will roll out in mid-2025, with public preview in June and general availability in July. No admin action is required.

title: Changes to how users install Microsoft 365 apps from the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Microsoft 365 app self-installation will move from the My account portal to a new modal in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on web and desktop. Organizations should update communications and use admin center settings or APIs to control installs, as Conditional Access no longer blocks self-installs. Updates expected by March 2026.

title: OneDrive: ask Copilot questions on meeting recordings
description: OneDrive will introduce Copilot for meeting recordings, providing actionable insights and immediate answers via Q&A. This feature will be available globally from late May to mid-June 2025. Users can recap meetings, generate notes, and highlight @mentions. No admin action is required; notify users and update documentation.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Viva Glint: Viva Glint admin can enable Copilot for the Company admin user role
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Viva Glint can now be enabled by Viva Glint admins for the Company admin user role. This feature will roll out from late July 2025 to late August 2025. No admin action is required before the rollout, but organizations should review their configurations and notify users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Open Copilot Pages content in a Word document
description: Microsoft Copilot users can convert content from Copilot Pages to a Word document with one button press, enhancing productivity. This feature will roll out in late May 2025 and complete by mid-June 2025. No IT admin action is required unless Copilot Pages are disabled.

title: Expanding reference capabilities with Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word now allows referencing entire folders, supports larger documents up to 1.5 million words or 3000 pages, and can reference up to 20 items. These features will be generally available by early December 2025. Folder referencing is available now for Word for the web and coming to other platforms in July 2025.

title: OneNote Pages in M365 Copilot Chat
description: M365 Copilot Chat can now reason over OneNote Pages, allowing users to summarize takeaways or list action items. This feature will roll out from late April to mid-May 2025. Organizations should update training and documentation. Features are available to users with a Copilot license.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: People Skills will be available starting in May
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot: People Skills will be available starting in June 2025, offering skill inferencing and a customizable skills library to enhance user profiles and organizational insights. It includes personalized skills in Microsoft 365 experiences and a Skill Discovery agent for employees and leaders. Setup is quick via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

title: (Highlight) Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Updates for unlicensed Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (Wave 2 Spring release)
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app's Wave 2 Spring release updates for unlicensed users include a refreshed navigation pane, simplified Copilot Chat experience, and an Agent Store. The rollout begins mid-May 2025 for targeted release and late May 2025 for general availability. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

title: Additional breakdown metrics by app for Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat standalone report
description: Additional breakdown metrics by app for Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat standalone report will be available starting early May 2025. The update includes active users and last activity dates for apps like Copilot.cloud.microsoft, Teams, and Outlook. Adjust custom reports to incorporate these new metrics.

title: Microsoft Purview | ​Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Copilot in Office from processing labeled content
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will extend to Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, allowing DLP policies to exclude processing of labeled content by Copilot. Public Preview starts mid-May 2025, with General Availability in late June 2025. No preparation is required other than creating DLP policies and assigning licenses.

title: Pages created in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will open in Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Pages created in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will open in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app starting May 2025. This change centralizes content in the Copilot app. Sensitivity labels will be available by late April 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

title: Microsoft Teams admin center: Improvements to controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Improvements to Microsoft 365 Copilot controls in the Microsoft Teams admin center will roll out from April to May 2025. This update simplifies settings, preventing errors when Copilot requires transcripts that are disabled. Admins need not take action but should inform users and review settings.

title: Teams Meetings Copilot response can be shared to external apps (Word or Excel)
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot responses in Teams meetings can be shared to Word or Excel via an "Open in" button, starting May 2025. This feature is triggered by long responses or tables and respects meeting policies and sensitivity labels. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile apps: Generate images
description: Coming soon: Users can create images using natural language to visualize concepts and ideas in the flow of work in iOS/Android mobile apps for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Outlook. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license or a Microsoft 365 license is required to use this feature. When this will happen: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on mid-April 2025 and expect to complete by late April 2025. How this will affect your organization: This new feature w...

title: Advanced Insights - Copilot Headlines Report
description: A new Copilot Headlines report for Advanced Insights will be available from mid-April 2024 to early July 2025. It scans for unexpected Copilot usage and collaboration changes. Analysts can customize the report and use dynamic internal benchmarks. Admins can disable access for non-global partitions if needed.

title: Outlook: Draft with Copilot Highlight & Rewrite in classic Outlook for Windows
description: Outlook's Draft with Copilot feature will be available in late June 2025 for Public Preview and late July 2025 for General Availability. This feature allows users to improve email drafts by highlighting sections and using Copilot to iterate on the text. No preparation is needed.

title: Microsoft 365 network connectivity test for Microsoft 365 Copilot is generally available
description: The Microsoft 365 network connectivity test for Microsoft 365 Copilot is rolling out worldwide to general availability. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is not required to use this feature. When this will happen: General Availability (Worldwide): We began rolling out in late March 2025 and expect to complete by early April 2025. How this will affect your organization: With this tool, users can locally run a network connectivity test to measure the performance from their device and location and th...

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: New Microsoft Graph connectors for the chat experience and more
description: New Microsoft Graph Connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat are now available, enhancing access to business content across various platforms like Guru, GitLab, Asana, 15Five, Miro, Trello, Zendesk, SmartSheet, and Seismic. No admin action is required for the rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Generate a summary for Pulse reports using Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Microsoft Viva Pulse will use Microsoft 365 Copilot to generate summaries for Pulse reports, aiding authors in quickly understanding the feedback. This feature, available across various platforms, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot or Viva Pulse license. The rollout will complete by late April 2025, with no admin action needed.

title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded AI admin role to manage Microsoft Copilot Dashboard settings
description: Microsoft Viva is expanding the AI Administrator role to manage Microsoft Copilot Dashboard settings without requiring Global admin privileges. This change, enhancing security and adhering to least-privilege practices, will roll out globally from mid to late April 2025. No action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Simplifying the default pinning configuration
description: Microsoft is simplifying the default pinning configuration for Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365 apps, impacting users without a Copilot license. The default will change from prompting users to pin to automatically pinning Copilot Chat. This rollout begins May 1, 2025. Users can unpin Copilot Chat if desired.

title: Ability to Stop Copilot while it is generating a response
description: Users will be able to stop Copilot while it is generating a response. The rollout will start in late May 2025 for Targeted Release and mid-May 2025 for General Availability, completing by late June 2025. Update documentation if necessary.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Security Posture Management for AI: Additional Copilot integrations
description: Microsoft Purview will integrate Microsoft Copilot in Fabric and Microsoft Security Copilot, starting public preview in late March 2025 and general availability in late June 2025. No Copilot license is required. Admins must create a new policy to monitor interactions. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Admins can configure access to Pulse templates for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users
description: Admins can configure access to new Microsoft Viva Pulse templates for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users. This feature, available from late March to mid-April 2025, allows admins to manage template access and review content. No action is required before the rollout, but reviewing configurations and notifying users is recommended.

title: Microsoft Copilot Chat usage report improvements
description: Microsoft is updating the Microsoft Copilot Chat usage report to include active users from Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.cloud.microsoft. The rollout will start in early April 2025. Metrics like active users and last activity date in the admin center may change. Users should revise custom reports accordingly.

title: AI Admin role has permissions to manage Copilot agents
description: AI Admin role now has permissions to manage Copilot agents, previously requiring Global Admin privileges. This change will roll out in late March 2025. AI Admins can view, publish, reject, block, and update agents but cannot consent for permissions. They should familiarize themselves with the integrated app page.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Microsoft 365 Copilot: Users can insert cloud files in Copilot chat prompts
description: Users will soon be able to attach cloud files from OneDrive or SharePoint in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat via the Web tab. This feature will roll out in late April 2025 and requires no admin action. Users need a Microsoft 365 Copilot or Microsoft 365 license. Roadmap ID: 481139.

title: Microsoft Viva Learning: Copilot Academy will be available for all Microsoft 365 users
description: Microsoft Viva Learning's Copilot Academy will be available to all Microsoft 365 users starting late April 2025. Admins can manage access settings, and the academy will be accessible by default under the Academies tab. Monthly notifications will be sent to licensed users. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva Learning: "AI & Copilot Resources" provider will be available to all Viva Learning users
description: The "AI & Copilot Resources" provider will be available to all Viva Learning users by default starting late April 2025. Admins can manage its visibility. This change will happen automatically, and no action is required beforehand. Review configurations and notify users as needed.

title: Keep Edge up to date to continue using Copilot on the Edge sidebar
description: Keep Edge updated to version 134.0.3124.51 or newer to use Copilot on the Edge sidebar. Updates include independence from Bing authentication, support for file uploads on the 'Web' tab, and access for all eligible enterprise tenants. M365 Copilot license requirements remain unchanged.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recapping changes in Loop over extended periods
description: The Recap feature in Loop now allows users to summarize changes over extended periods, such as the last week or last 30 days. This update will roll out from mid-March to early April 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

title: Updates to pinning Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (“Copilot Chat”) within Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
description: Starting mid-March 2025, Copilot Chat will be automatically pinned in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app for eligible users who newly install the app or are redirected to it. Admins can block this pinning. This update applies only to mobile scenarios, with completion expected by mid-April 2025. No action is required unless admins want to prevent automatic pinning.

title: Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Outlook
description: Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Outlook are delayed. Targeted Release is now planned for late May 2025, and General Availability for early June 2025. Agents will appear in the right-side panel of Outlook, allowing customization. Admins can manage these agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

title: Change to Copilot Settings in Outlook
description: Starting in March 2025, Outlook will introduce a setting to hide Copilot entry points, configurable per account and syncing across all Outlook applications. This applies to both organizational and personal accounts. Classic Outlook for Windows will not have this setting, but changes will sync with it. Admins should inform users.

title: Discover agents in Microsoft Copilot iOS/Android
description: The Agent UX for Microsoft 365 Copilot, previously on desktop and web, is now available on mobile. Users can discover, add, and chat with agents in Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot app. Rollout starts mid-May 2025 and completes by late May 2025. No admin action required.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Chat sessions will have titles generated by large language models (LLM)
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will use large language models to generate titles for chat sessions starting March 2025. This feature, requiring a Microsoft 365 license, will enhance organization and discoverability. Users can still rename or delete sessions. For more details, refer to the provided roadmap ID 388373.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: End User License Requests & Self-Service Purchase
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will soon offer a new license request feature and self-service purchase option for various Microsoft 365 plans. Admins can manage license requests and self-service purchases in the admin center. The rollout begins in late March 2025 and completes by late May 2025. Existing self-service purchase settings will be honored.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Sway will retire from the "Create" tab
description: Sway will be retired from the "Create" tab in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app between March 24 and March 31, 2025, due to low usage. Users can still access Sway from the "Apps" section. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

title: Upcoming Changes for M365 Copilot Chat with Link Safety
description: Upcoming changes to M365 Copilot Chat include integration with SafeLinks for URL protection, native time-of-click URL reputation checks, and the cessation of hyperlink redaction. Rollout begins in late March 2025 and completes by late May 2025. These updates enhance link security in chat responses.

title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Microsoft 365 (Office) app is now the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Microsoft 365 (Office) app is now the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. Changes in the Microsoft Outlook apps for iOS and Android will occur in March 2025, including a new icon for Microsoft accounts. No admin action is required, but users should be notified. Learn more [here](https://support.microsoft.com/office/the-microsoft-365-app-transition-to-the-microsoft-365-copilot-app-22eac811-08d6-4df3-92dd-77f193e354a5).

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Microsoft Edge Mobile will support page summarization
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge Mobile for Android and iOS will re-enable page summarization features in two phases from mid-February to late March 2025. The Copilot Chat icon will be displayed by default to all Microsoft Entra ID users. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva Glint: Use Feature Access Management in Viva for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Glint
description: Microsoft Viva Glint will integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot into Feature Access Management, allowing admins to control its rollout and availability. Copilot is enabled by default in Viva but disabled in Viva Glint. Admins can use policies to manage access. The rollout starts in late February 2025 and completes by late May 2025. Subscription to Viva suite or Viva Glint is required.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app: The "Record" feature will retire
description: We will retire the video Record feature from the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app for Android and iOS starting March 17, 2025, and ending March 31, 2025. Instead, we recommend using the device's video recording feature. After the retirement, users will no longer be able to record new videos from the Capture tab but will be able to view and access videos that they have already recorded and saved in their Microsoft OneDrive account or on their device. This retirement will happen automatically by t...

title: Copilot Prompt Gallery Prompts app available soon
description: The Copilot Prompt Gallery Prompts app for Microsoft 365 will be available for general rollout from early to late February 2025. Users can install it from Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app stores. Ensure Teams apps are enabled and the Prompts app is configured for your tenant.

title: Video creation in Copilot Visual Creator powered by Clipchamp
description: Clipchamp's integration with Copilot Visual Creator allows users to generate videos from typed prompts, sourcing from Microsoft 365's stock media. Videos are saved in OneDrive and can be edited in Clipchamp. The feature rolls out from mid-February to mid-March 2025 and is available with Microsoft 365 Copilot plan. Users can control access and provide feedback within the app.

title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: New usage intensity and retention insights
description: Microsoft Viva Insights will enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot's adoption insights by adding usage intensity and retention metrics to the Copilot Dashboard. This update, which does not require a Copilot license to view, will roll out in late January 2025 and will be available by default. Admins and leaders can measure usage frequency and consistency with new visual tools and cards. Existing admin controls will be respected post-update. No admin action is needed before the rollout.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: AI administrator role authorization to manage Copilot settings
description: The AI administrator role in Microsoft 365 admin center authorizes users to manage Copilot settings, with a rollout starting in January 2025. No admin action is required for this update.

title: Multiple account access to Copilot in Microsoft 365 desktop and mobile apps
description: Starting March 2025, Microsoft 365 will allow multiple account access to Copilot in desktop and mobile apps, enabling users to use Copilot on any permitted document across accounts. Enterprise data protection applies based on file access identity. Admins can restrict this via a Cloud Policy available by January 2025.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat rolling out, IT admin resources available
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now available for Entra account users with a Microsoft 365 subscription at no extra cost. It offers secure AI chat, pay-as-you-go agents, and IT controls. Admins need to enable agents for shared tenant data, and resources are provided to assist with deployment and user engagement.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Separate retention policies for Copilot and AI apps
description: Admins can now configure separate retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI apps. The public preview starts in late May 2025, with general availability in mid-September 2025. This feature is enabled by default and requires no admin action. More details are available in the provided link.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Set up "Pay-as-you-go billing" in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: Updated January 9, 2025: We are in the process of making updates to this message to provide additional information and clarification. Thank you for your feedback. We will introduce pay-as-you-go (PayG) billing for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 admin center. When this will happen: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out late January 2025 and expect to complete by mid-February 2025. How this will affect your organization: After this rollout, admins will have t...

title: Microsoft Viva Engage: New features for Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption community
description: Microsoft Viva Engage is introducing new features to support Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, including question recommendations and admin controls to manage community features. The rollout begins mid-January 2025 and completes by mid-February 2025. No action is required from admins before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Teams: Using Copilot agents in group chats
description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to add Microsoft 365 Copilot agents to group chats for increased productivity, without needing a Copilot license. The feature will roll out in early February 2025 and will be available on various desktop platforms and the web. It will be enabled by default but can be disabled if desired.

title: Viva Learning: AI and Copilot Resources Provider visibility
description: The AI and Copilot Resources Provider for Microsoft Copilot Academy will be visible by default to users with Copilot licenses starting mid-February 2025. Admins can manage permissions and content visibility. The rollout requires no admin action but updating documentation is advised. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 412064 details this update.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Enhancements to Copilot administration page
description: The Microsoft 365 admin center's Copilot page will be updated with an enhanced Overview section and a new Health section. Rollout starts late January 2025 and ends by late March 2025, requiring no license or admin action prior to rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva: Leaders can use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Viva Insights
description: Microsoft Viva Insights will soon integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot, enabling leaders to analyze organizational data and generate reports. New features include query capabilities and Copilot-driven reports. The update requires a Viva Insights premium license and will be available on various Teams platforms, with a Public Preview in December 2024 and General Availability in January 2025. No additional Copilot license is needed.

title: Important updates to Microsoft Copilot and the Microsoft 365 app
description: We are making several important updates to how your entire organization can experience Microsoft Copilot, our existing ad-free, AI-powered chat service grounded in the web and secured with enterprise data protection. Starting in mid-January, we will roll out the following changes: We are making name changes to simplify the user experience. Microsoft Copilot for Entra account users will be renamed Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Additionally, the Microsoft 365 app will be named Microsoft 365 Copilot,...

title: Microsoft 365 file sensitivity labels in Copilot responses availability update
description: Updated February 5, 2025: After further review we have decided not to proceed with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Copilot will show current sensitivity label settings to users for any Microsoft 365 file used to ground a prompt in Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat web mode and Microsoft Copilot with enterprise data protection web grounding chat. These are the same sensitivity settings displayed across Microsoft 365 products like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint...

title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out Chat, Copilot, and Notes panes in meetings
description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to pop out Notes, Chat, and Copilot panes in meetings. The targeted release is from mid-January to early February 2025, with general availability from late June to early July 2025. The Copilot pane requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. No admin action is needed.

title: Microsoft Teams: Seamlessly share apps and Microsoft 365 Copilot agents
description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow seamless sharing of apps and Microsoft 365 Copilot agents within chats and channels. No license is needed to share, but usage requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Rollout starts mid-December 2024, with new features like detailed cards, shortened URLs, and an updated sharing experience.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Gain policy insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot for Security
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Security in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now includes Policy Insights, helping admins understand and manage DLP policies. The rollout for general availability is rescheduled to late April 2025. This feature is not available for US government cloud customers. Admins can prepare by acquiring Security Computer Units (SCUs).

title: Microsoft Viva Pulse experience will be included with Microsoft 365 Copilot subscription
description: Microsoft Viva Pulse will be included with the Microsoft 365 Copilot subscription, rolling out early to mid-December 2024. Users with Copilot or Viva Pulse premium licenses can create and send Pulse surveys. Full access requires a premium license. Rollout requires no admin action and features will be enabled by default.

title: Image input support in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Copilot
description: Starting late January 2025, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Copilot users with an Entra account can upload images for analysis in various apps. Rollout completion is expected by early March 2025. This feature will be available without tenant level configuration and respects existing user availability controls.

title: 8 new Copilot feature metrics in Copilot dashboard and Viva Insights advanced insights, including Business Chat (web)
description: 8 new Copilot feature metrics are now generally available in the Copilot Dashboard and Viva Insights Advanced insights. The new Copilot feature metrics being added, include: “Intelligent Recap” actions taken in Teams “Visualize as table” actions taken in Word “Chat (Copilot in Word)” prompts submitted in the in-app chat section in Word “Add content to presentation” actions taken using PowerPoint “Organize presentation” actions taken using PowerPoint “Chat (Copilot in PowerPoint)” prompts submitt...

title: Microsoft Viva: Microsoft 365 Copilot now available to Viva Insights analysts
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now available in Viva Insights for analysts, enhancing report building with suggested templates and queries. Rollout begins December 2024, completing January 2025. It's on by default but can be disabled. No admin action is required before rollout.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Business Chat usage in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report
description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center will be updated to show total usage of Business Chat and split usage of Business Chat (work) and Business Chat (web). Business Chat (web) usage is currently limited to Microsoft Edge and Microsoft 365 App, but more apps will be added over time. The Business Chat (work) usage in Edge and Microsoft 365 App was already captured in the report as part of the Business Chat (work) metric, but now we are breaking them out in the ad...

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: New user license requests
description: Coming soon: A new license request feature for Microsoft 365 Copilot will be widely available. This new capability allows users to request a Microsoft 365 Copilot license directly from their admin. This helps you efficiently assign unused licenses or purchase additional ones as needed. Global admins, license admins, and user admins will be able to manage these requests seamlessly in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Microsoft will enable users to self-service purchase or request a license from you...

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot using content with sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will soon extend to support Microsoft 365 Copilot. DLP policies will be able to identify sensitive documents based on sensitivity labels and exclude processing for Copilot interactions in Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat. Updated February 6, 2025: We have updated the rollout timeline below. Thank you for your patience. The preview does not support alerts, incident reports, and policy simulation. Audit records will be available at a later time after...

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management with Copilot (preview)
description: Microsoft Purview's Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) preview, initially set for late November 2024, will now begin mid-December 2024 and complete by late January 2025. DSPM helps identify and correct vulnerable data configurations, integrating insights from user and data risk. It includes Microsoft Security Copilot features for efficient risk identification and mitigation. Prerequisites include specific Microsoft 365 licenses and enabling DSPM in the Purview portal. Rollout will occur aut...

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage reports for Microsoft Copilot with enterprise data protection
description: A new Microsoft Copilot usage report will be added to the Microsoft 365 admin center in mid-November 2024, providing insights into active usage and enterprise data protection. This report includes user activity metrics and trends, and will be available by default with no required admin action.

title: Microsoft Copilot: New user control for web searches
description: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with the new user control for web searches in Microsoft Copilot at this time. Users would have been able to enable or disable web searches via a control in the three-dot menu, but this change is currently on hold.

title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Separate Copilot retention policies from Teams chats
description: Admins can now create separate retention policies for Microsoft Teams chats and Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions using PowerShell cmdlets or the UI. This feature requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and will be available in Public Preview in May 2025 and General Availability in September 2025. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Copilot 365 in Viva Glint will support the summarization of employee survey comments
description: Starting November 2024, Microsoft Copilot 365 in Viva Glint will summarize employee survey comments, identify themes, and suggest actions. It requires a Viva Glint license and admin configuration. Public Preview begins June 2024, with General Availability in November 2024. Roadmap ID: 324079.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat available in Teams and Outlook
description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, previously Microsoft Copilot, will be available in Teams and Outlook for Entra account users starting late January 2025, with the rollout completing by mid-March. It will be automatically pinned for licensed users, and others can pin it manually or add it from the Store. Admins have control over the pinning settings.

title: Microsoft Viva Engage: New features for Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption community
description: Coming soon to the Microsoft Viva Engage adoption community for Microsoft 365 Copilot, admins will have access to new suggested content covering timely Copilot updates and best practices and the ability to easily upload documents and leverage AI to generate Q&A pairs using Answers Intelligent Importer. What is the Microsoft Viva Engage adoption community for Copilot?
