title: Copilot Pages coming to Microsoft Copilot
description: Copilot Pages will be available in Microsoft Copilot for users with an Entra account and SharePoint license starting early November 2024. This feature allows for collaborative and persistent workspaces in Copilot chat. It will be enabled by default with admin controls for customization.

title: Microsoft Viva: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Viva Amplify
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now available in Viva Amplify to improve authoring with AI. It's accessible without a Copilot license if you have a Viva Amplify license. Copilot offers rewriting, length adjustment, and tone setting features but is not available on SharePoint or mobile apps. No admin action is needed for the rollout.

title: Microsoft Copilot in Edge will support page summarization and user prompt suggestions
description: Starting early November 2024, Microsoft Copilot in Edge will reintroduce page summarization and contextual prompt suggestions, available for users signed in with a Microsoft Entra account or using Microsoft 365 Copilot in web mode. Rollout will be automatic, and admins can configure the feature.

title: Manage web searches in Copilot separately from optional connected experiences with new policy
description: In November 2024, Microsoft will introduce the "Allow web search in Copilot" policy, enabling separate management of web searches in Microsoft 365 Copilot from other optional connected experiences. This policy allows for improved Copilot responses using Bing search service and can be configured at the user/group level.

title: Preview new Graph connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces an early preview of new Graph connectors, including GitHub, Google Drive, and others, with limited availability starting from October 2024. Sign-ups for the preview are open via a form or email. These connectors allow indexing of third-party content, enhancing search capabilities across Microsoft Search clients.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Self-service purchase settings in Microsoft 365 admin center (E3, E5)
description: In October 2024, Microsoft 365 Copilot self-service purchase settings will be available in the admin center for E3 and E5 license holders. Global and billing admins can set preferences ahead of the rollout, which will happen automatically. Settings are enabled by default but can be managed or disabled.

title: Changes coming to the Copilot experience for Windows
description: The Copilot experience for Windows is updating to include enterprise data protection at no extra cost and will be accessed via the Microsoft 365 app. Changes begin with a preview release on September 24, 2024, and a security update on October 8, 2024, for Windows 11, followed by Windows 10. Organizations should prepare by adjusting their settings and pinning the Microsoft 365 app if needed.

title: Microsoft Teams apps and Microsoft Copilot extensions: New security and certification information
description: New Microsoft Teams apps and Copilot extensions will provide admins with security and certification information for compliance assessment. This feature, available in the Teams and Microsoft 365 admin centers, will include Microsoft 365 certification outcomes and ISV-submitted data. It will roll out worldwide from late October to late November 2024 and is on by default. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Copilot to update to enterprise data protection
description: Microsoft Copilot will update next month to include enterprise data protection for users with an Entra account. It will feature a new ad-free interface, with no changes for other Copilot experiences in Microsoft 365 apps. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with no action needed for automatic redirection.

title: Copilot in the Microsoft Edge mobile application is being retired for Entra ID users
description: The Copilot feature in the Microsoft Edge mobile app for Entra ID users will be retired with version 128 in late August 2024. Users should use the Microsoft 365 mobile app for work and web chat instead. No action is required, but informing users is recommended.

title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Enhanced alert and user investigation with Microsoft Copilot for Security
description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management now includes enhanced alert and user investigation with Microsoft Copilot for Security. The rollout timeline has been updated, with public preview in August 2024 and general availability in June 2025. Users need a Copilot for Security license and proper permissions. No admin action is required before the rollout.

title: Microsoft Viva Insights: Delegate access to Microsoft Copilot Dashboard
description: Microsoft Viva Insights will soon allow leaders to delegate access to their Copilot Dashboard to designated individuals within their company. This feature will enable delegates to view insights and make informed decisions, without seeing the leader's personal insights. It will be available on various platforms and is associated with Roadmap ID 398976. Rollout begins mid-July 2024. Admins can manage access with policies, and the feature is enabled by default. title: Microsoft Teams: Organizers can manage access to meeting transcripts, recordings, AI-generated recap, and Copilot
description: Microsoft Teams meeting organizers can soon manage access to recordings, transcripts, AI recaps, and Copilot features. This will roll out in June 2024, with settings accessible under the 'Recording and transcript' tab. Options include access for everyone, organizers only, or specific people. The default setting is 'Everyone.'

title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit Consent policy for Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365
description: Microsoft Teams introduces an Explicit Consent policy for user content in meetings, requiring participant agreement for audio and video use in transcription, recording, or Microsoft Copilot. Organizations can enable this policy through the Teams Admin Center. Rollout starts mid-June 2024, with completion by late June 2024.

title: Microsoft Teams: Shifts plugin in Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365
description: The Shifts plugin is now available in Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 within Teams, allowing users to inquire about team shifts and time off. Rollout starts early June 2024, completing by early July. To prepare, admins must deploy the plugin and users need to authenticate it.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot assisted hours update in Microsoft Copilot dashboard
description: Microsoft Viva is updating the Copilot Dashboard to provide a detailed breakdown of Copilot assisted hours for Viva or Viva Insights subscribers. The update, which requires no admin action, will start rolling out in early May 2024 and complete by mid-May 2024. Users should be informed of this change.

title: Chat history coming to Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise) - ON HOLD
description: The rollout of chat history for Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection is on hold. It allows users to view and continue past chats. A PowerShell script is available to manage this feature, which will be rolled out in mid to late May 2024. Users must consent to new terms to use chat history, which is stored for 30 days.

title: Microsoft Viva: Minimum group size update for Copilot Dashboard
description: Microsoft Viva's Copilot Dashboard now shows tenant-level metrics without a minimum group size requirement and user-level metrics with a reduced minimum group size threshold, which can be configured by the Viva Insights administrator. These changes are available now and affect data visualization and privacy settings.

title: Microsoft Viva Learning: New content updates in Viva Learning and Copilot Academy
description: Viva Learning is adding new content and Copilot Academy will be available in seven new languages. Admins can enable/disable these features in the Manage Academies and Manage providers sections. Rollout starts mid-May 2024, with completion by late May 2024. Users can access new resources and language options in Copilot Academy and discover new courses in Viva Learning.

title: Microsoft Copilot in Intune is available in Public Preview
description: Microsoft Copilot in Intune is now in public preview, offering AI insights for quicker issue resolution and optimized policy settings. It assists with policy management and device troubleshooting. Preparation involves learning about Microsoft Copilot for Security and starting with Copilot for Security and Copilot in Intune. Early Access customers must transition after six months.

title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Copilot for Security capabilities
description: Microsoft Purview's integration with Copilot for Security will improve security incident investigations starting early April 2024, offering enhanced visibility and user risk context, with no admin action required before rollout.

title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Microsoft Copilot for Security Alert summary
description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon include Microsoft Copilot for Security to summarize alerts and expedite data security investigations. Public preview begins in April 2024, with general availability in May. Users need Copilot for Security licenses and specific permissions to use this feature.

title: Microsoft Purview | Communication Compliance: Contextual Summaries with Copilot for Security
description: Microsoft Purview's Communication Compliance will introduce contextual summaries of policy matches in Copilot for Security. This feature will help investigators identify potentially risky content and understand the meaning of the content with just one click. Public preview will begin in early April 2024 and general availability worldwide will begin in early May 2024. description: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 UI will be updated to create better visual alignment with Microsoft Copilot (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise). The updates include adding a green shield icon, a persistent legal and data protection disclaimer, a new AI accuracy disclaimer, and removing company branding/logo from the UI. title: Teams Mobile: New citations for Copilot in Teams responses in meetings and calls
description: Copilot responses in Microsoft Teams Mobile meetings and calls will include a citation number for easy access to the content source. The rollout will begin mid-April 2024 and no admin action is required. Improved user experience and productivity is expected.

title: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365: Enterprise grounding and Web grounding in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote
description: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 will enable graph grounding and web grounding in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote. description: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 is introducing Restricted SharePoint Search, allowing organizations to disable organization-wide search and restrict both Enterprise Search and Copilot experiences to a curated set of SharePoint sites. title: Copilot responses improved with web content
description: Starting late March, the default state of the Web Content toggle for users will be "On" for Copilot in Microsoft 365 with Graph-grounded chat experience, allowing Copilot to enhance responses with information from the internet. Admins should verify tenant level settings and educate users accordingly.

title: Copilot in Forms
description: Microsoft Forms has a new feature called Copilot that allows users to create forms and customize themes quickly and easily. Copilot generates a form based on the user's natural language description, and users can refine it as needed. It can save time and effort, improve quality and accuracy, and enhance engagement and insights. To use Copilot in Forms, users need a Microsoft 365 account and access to Microsoft Forms. The feature will be rolled out from late February 2024 to early March 2024.

title: AccessedResources field populated in Purview for Meeting Copilot Interactions
description: Microsoft Purview users will soon see the AccessedResources field populated in Purview for Meeting Copilot Interactions, containing a link to the meeting recording MP4 file. This update will be rolled out from mid-March 2024 to late March 2024. Admins may want to update internal documentation as appropriate.

title: Date Dividers: New Copilot for Microsoft 365 UI enhancements in Microsoft Teams Chat, Channel, Meeting, and Calling
description: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Microsoft Teams Chat, Channel, Meeting, and Calling will soon have an enhancement to improve the overall user experience. title: Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Teams chat on mobile
description: Microsoft 365's Copilot will be available in Teams iOS and Android App for licensed users, appearing at the top of the Chat list for easy access. The update will roll out to commercial tenants in early March 2024, and users can continue to use it as before.

title: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365: Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings
description: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365: Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings. Admins can enable the Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings, which allows Copilot for Microsoft 365 to access Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales data to retrieve sales information and brand information for the account mentioned. The plugin will be available for eligible end-users in late May 2024. Admins should enable the plugin for end-users to use the feature.

title: Transitioning from Microsoft 365 Chat to Copilot in Teams
description: Microsoft 365 Chat in Teams will be replaced by Copilot app starting early March 2024, and users are advised to use Copilot instead. Copilot licensed users won't be able to use M365 Chat app in Teams. Previous chat history won't be transferred to Copilot. Refer to the provided link for more information.

description: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding access to the Copilot Dashboard (Preview) and introducing new admin controls. description: Microsoft is moving admin center controls for Microsoft Search in Bing and Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Bing, Edge, and Windows to provide additional flexibility in managing search for organizations. title: Microsoft Word for the web: New AI-generated document summary when sharing
description: Microsoft Word for the web will soon allow users with a Copilot for Microsoft 365 license to include an AI-generated document summary when sharing a Word document. The summary can be included in the share notification email sent to the recipient(s) to provide more context. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout, which will begin mid-March 2024 and complete by late March 2024.

description: Starting today, the Microsoft Copilot user interface (UI) is updating to a more streamlined look and feel based on user feedback. description: PowerShell and Microsoft Entra admin center now support Copilot welcome emails for licenses assigned outside of the Microsoft 365 admin center. title: Multi-Turn Conversations Supported in Copilot in Microsoft Teams chat and channels
description: Copilot in Microsoft Teams chat and channels will soon support multi-turn conversations, allowing users to ask follow-up questions to a Copilot response. This feature will be available on Desktop, Web, and Mobile starting from early April 2024. Users are advised to notify their teams and update internal documentation as needed.

description: Updated February 27, 2024: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Power BI app, has been delisted from AppSource. title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Viva Insights licensed customers
description: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Viva Insights licensed customers will offer additional insights combining usage metrics with collaboration and sentiment data. It will provide granular views on adoption, usage patterns, and ROI. Rollout begins in April 2024, with completion by May 2024. Users can create custom reports and view metrics by organizational attributes. Preparation involves reviewing access management and learning about dashboard metrics.

description: Search based plugins for Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 were rolled out in November 2023 to all tenants licensed for Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365. description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot will preserve side pane preferences for a specific chat thread while the app is running. This feature will be available on desktop and web. The rollout will start in early March 2024 and will be completed by late March 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this change.
